title: Production Zapret PowerShell query diagnostics
observedProblem: Actual signed fresh380 SYSTEM component.query log exposes only reconstructed error.message. It loses original execFile code/killed/signal/pid/elapsed and cannot distinguish timeout, native exit or failed spawn.

change.clock: performance.now monotonic duration rounded to integer milliseconds
change.pidOrigin: The original promise returned by promisify(execFile).child.pid, positive integer or null
change.scalarPolicy: Fixed known code/signal strings and bounded numeric code/PID; unfamiliar strings become unknown.
change.causePreserved: WinWS error.cause -> PowerShellExecutionError.cause -> original native error. Native cause is nonenumerable and retained only in process.
change.coreVisibleErrorMessage: Fixed prefix plus safe scalar metadata; no command, output text, child argv/path or user configuration is included.
change.stdoutStderrPolicy: Byte counts only, no stderr free text. Buffer length is exact; string length is UTF8 byte length of the existing decoded execFile API result, not an assertion of original pipe encoding.
change.invalidJsonPolicy: Fixed safe JSON parse message; original SyntaxError remains cause without echoing its output excerpt.

before.meaning: Original production wrapper did not preserve metadata/cause and exposed synthetic input/output in public errors.

afterCompatibility.resultBasis: Completed TAP1..66 with zero failed/cancelled/skipped tests; standalone new module also has separate actual exit0 receipt.

regressionGroups: actual harmless child exit retains metadata and original cause through WinWS wrapper
actual own child timeout differs from nonzero exit without claiming provider cause
actual nonexistent own executable spawn failure has no PID and no path disclosure
actual output-limit failure is distinct from timeout and never emits captured output
successful own child keeps stdout and WinWS empty-result semantics unchanged
invalid JSON output is a fixed safe parse error while preserving SyntaxError cause
unrecognized error string fields are not reflected into public diagnostics
verification.syntheticInputPropertyCase: Unknown code/signal strings and synthetic input/stdout/stderr are suppressed; original error remains accessible only as cause.
verification.messageBoundRegression: Each public failure message <=512 characters and omits synthetic sensitive marker, input/CommandLine, executable path and captured stdout/stderr.

limitations: No actual SYSTEM worker or WinPS CIM failure was reproduced by these own harmless Node children. They verify production error wrapping and native child metadata, not the hosted provider root cause.
The earlier actual normal-vs-eight-key WinPS A/B succeeded under a nonadmin user; adding missing environment variables is not justified.

kind=terminated/killed=true records observed child termination; it is not a claim that the WMI provider caused a timeout. Elapsed, budget, code and signal are retained for the next actual native decision.
No app/Setup/service start, SCM/DNS/Tasks/registry mutation, live process stop, SYSTEM impersonation, UI/CI/main/ComponentWorker/protocol edit, build/package/commit/push or publication was performed.
Parent integration/build/sign and actual source-bound hosted SYSTEM execution remain required. No uptime or release-readiness claim follows from this change.
nextDecisiveObservation: Read the next actual source-bound SYSTEM Core component.query error: code/killed/signal/elapsed/pid/output byte counts now survive the existing message-only worker protocol; use them before any timeout/environment fix.
